name: Load and Play Back a Real EEG Recording
description:
The OpenBCI GUI is open at the System Control Panel. A real EEG recording file is available in the Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings folder. This recording is from the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (Subject 1, baseline recording with eyes open).

Your task is to load and play back this EEG recording:

1. In the System Control Panel, locate the data source selection.
2. Select 'PLAYBACK (from file)' as the data source.
3. You will need to select the recording file. The file is located at:
   ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings/OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt
4. Once the file is selected, click 'START SESSION' to begin playback.
5. The GUI should start playing back the real EEG data, showing the time series waveforms scrolling across the screen.

This recording contains 8 channels of real human EEG data recorded at 250 Hz, converted from the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb 1.0.0). The data represents approximately 61 seconds of eyes-open baseline EEG activity.

After completing this task, the OpenBCI GUI should be playing back the EEG recording with the Time Series widget showing the scrolling EEG waveforms from the file.

metadata.data_subject: Subject S001, Run R01 (eyes open baseline)
